rows.note: Use 進步 as the all-purpose noun for general progress or improvement, including advancement in learning.

example.english: Your advancement in learning Cantonese has been great lately.
example.traditional: 你最近學廣東話進步咗好多。
example.jyutping: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 zeon3 bou6 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use 升職 for the employment-related slice of advancement: promotion to a higher job rank.

example.english: They finally got an advancement at work this year.
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 nin4 zung1 jyu1 sing1 zik1 laa3

rows.note: Use 進度 for how far a project, process, or piece of work has advanced.

example.english: The advancement of this project is a bit slow.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 zeon3 dou6 jau5 di1 maan6

rows.note: Use 預付款 for money paid before goods or services are supplied.

example.english: You need to make an advancement payment before we supply the goods.
example.jyutping: deng6 fo3 jiu3 sin1 bei2 jyu6 fu6 fun2
